(AI Generated).

## Freed v26.8.2001-dev

Descriptor-bound Library sidecar, enforce PWA actor capabilities, and fail-closed Library service supervisor

### Features

- Descriptor-bound Library sidecar
- Enforce PWA actor capabilities
- Fail-closed Library service supervisor

### Fixes

- Support local-only Library authority
- Bound Drive checkpoint pages by bytes
- Recognize refreshed promotion backflow
- Bound Library Core search parity
- Preserve PWA intents across checkpoints
- Repair Drive mutable revision fencing
- Enforce one Library Core process per data root
- Establish native SQLite Library authority
- Route CI away from stalled Ubuntu mirrors
- Keep SQLite backups off cloud storage
- Sanitize runner sources before apt update
- Drive Library Core bootstrap are now more stable
- Show honest Drive sync activity
- Read immutable Drive objects without browser ETags
- Prevent Drive sync lifecycle stalls

### Follow-ups

- Prepare v26.8.2000-dev
- Retire competing Library journal runtime
- Retire operation field registry runtime
- Share native checkpoint store primitives
- Reverse integrate v26.8.1901 release identity
- Enforce actor capability certificates
- Extract native Library Core
- Extract Library Primary coordinator
- Close retired Automerge runtime boundary
- Content-addressed Library media transport
- PWA IndexedDB Library parity
- Build editable SQLite Library followers
- Merge main back into dev after v26.8.1500

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
